     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAff
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam
    12	
    13	The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
    14	module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
    15	representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.
    16	
    17	The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
    18	two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
    19	representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.
    20	
    21	This is not an unconditional Picard representability result: the final declaration below retains
    22	both geometric inputs.  Moreover, at the larger admissible coverage parameter the raw Abel map has
    23	positive-dimensional linear-system fibres in positive genus, so the larger divisor representer
    24	cannot simply be substituted as an open chart source.  The remaining datum-tail construction is
    25	the corrected Altman--Kleiman step: represent the quotient by equality of the induced Picard class,
    26	thereby removing those fibres before applying the Picard representability seam.
    27	
    28	## Main declarations
    29	
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffGenus` is the widened Abel chart formed from the chosen
    31	  genus-parameter divisor representer.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffGenus` is its universal widened divisor family.
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineGenusChart` restricts a multi-index family of these maps to chosen
    34	  source opens.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts` is the conditional final assembly
    36	  once the restricted charts are open immersions and cover pointwise.
    37	-/
    38	
    39	set_option autoImplicit false
    40	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    41	
    42	universe u
    43	
    44	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    45	
    46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    47	
    48	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    49	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    50	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    51	
    52	noncomputable section
    53	
    54	/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the chosen genus-parameter representer. -/
    55	def universalDivFamAffGenus :
    56	    divFamZarAff C (genus C) (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
    57	  (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    58	
    59	/-- Pulling back the chosen universal family gives the widened family classified by the
    60	corresponding morphism into the genus representer. -/
    61	theorem universalDivFamAffGenus_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    62	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    63	    divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) q (universalDivFamAffGenus C)
    64	      = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
    65	  have h := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    66	    (𝟙 (divRepAffGenusScheme C))
    67	  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
    68	  exact h.symm
    69	
    70	/-- The widened Abel chart at the genus parameter, using the challenge curve's chosen divisor
    71	representer rather than accepting a representability witness as an argument. -/
    72	def abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    73	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    74	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    75	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ)) :
    76	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
    77	  abelSigmaChartAff C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg
    78	
    79	/-- The structure morphism read from a genus-parameter widened Abel chart is the structure
    80	morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
    81	lemma chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    82	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    83	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    84	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    85	    {ι : Type u} (i : ι) :
    86	    chartHom C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffGenus C m Z hdeg) i
    87	      = (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
    88	  chartHom_abelSigmaChartAff (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg i
    89	
    90	/-- A multi-index family of genus-parameter widened Abel charts, restricted to source opens.
    91	Different indices may use different twists and different opens, but they all use the same
    92	unconditional divisor representer. -/
    93	def affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
    94	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    95	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
    96	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    97	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
    98	    yoneda.obj (V i : Scheme) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
    99	  restrictChart (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i)
   100	
   101	/-- The structure morphism of a restricted genus chart is the inclusion of its source open
   102	followed by the structure morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
   103	lemma chartHom_affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
   104	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   105	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
   106	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   107	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
   108	    chartHom C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) i
   109	      = (V i).ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom := by
   110	  calc
   111	    chartHom C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) i =
   112	        chartHom C (fun _ : ι => restrictChart
   113	          (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i)) i := rfl
   114	    _ = (V i).ι ≫ chartHom C
   115	          (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) i :=
   116	      chartHom_restrictChart
   117	        (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i) i
   118	    _ = (V i).ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
   119	      congrArg ((V i).ι ≫ ·)
   120	        (chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i) i)
   121	
   122	/-- The degree-zero Picard functor is represented by the glued object of any pointwise-covering
   123	family of open genus-parameter widened Abel charts.
   124	
   125	The divisor representation is construction data, not a hypothesis: it is supplied by
   126	`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`.  The two hypotheses are exactly the geometric inputs of
   127	Zariski local representability. -/
   128	def pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts {ι : Type u}
   129	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   130	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
   131	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   132	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens)
   133	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V i))
   134	    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :
   135	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   136	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
   137	      (Sigma.desc (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :=
   138	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C _ hcov
   139	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) hf⟩
   140	
   141	end
   142	
   143	end AlgebraicGeometry
